A '''Verpine''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] that stood at two [[Meter/Legends|meters]] was a [[Merchant/Legends|salesclerk]] in an [[Unidentified electronics store|electronics store]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] entered the store to buy an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] toy. As she knew the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] would have eagerly described everything in the electronics store, she did not give him a chance to do so, quickly buying the toy and several electronic components before leaving.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Verpine appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
